themes.name: Grid Infrastructure & Power Generation
themes.thesis_summary: AI's exponential power demand is creating an unprecedented infrastructure bottleneck where technological advancement is being constrained by physical power delivery. With data centers needing 5x-7x more power while grid infrastructure takes 5-15 years to build, this represents a massive multi-year investment cycle that's barely begun.
key_catalysts: AI data center power demand surge
Transformer lead times at 143 weeks
Grid investment needs to double to $600B by 2030
1,500 GW renewable projects waiting for grid connection

themes.name: Defense Manufacturing & Supply Chain Security
themes.thesis_summary: Defense spending surge is creating bottlenecks in manufacturing capacity and supply chain resilience that require multi-year rebuilding efforts. Focus on companies solving critical supply constraints rather than just benefiting from budget increases.
key_catalysts: Europe defense spending to double to €650-750B by 2030
Russell 2000 Aerospace & Defense +358% earnings growth forecast
Ukraine conflict exposing supply bottlenecks
Supply chain reshoring mandates

themes.name: Precious Metals & Alternative Stores of Value
themes.thesis_summary: Precious metals benefiting from unique combination of industrial demand (AI/renewables driving silver) and financial demand (fiscal concerns driving gold). Silver's industrial usage provides more durable demand than purely financial plays.
key_catalysts: Industrial silver demand from AI/renewable tech
Fiscal concerns driving debasement trade
Central bank gold purchases
Supply constraints in mining

themes.name: Energy Storage & Battery Infrastructure
themes.thesis_summary: Energy storage is the critical enabler for both renewable grid integration and AI data center backup power. Theme benefits from solving multiple infrastructure bottlenecks simultaneously while supply chain constraints create additional pricing power.
key_catalysts: Grid modernization requiring storage for renewables
AI data centers needing backup power systems
EV charging infrastructure expansion
China rare earth export restrictions

themes.name: Communication Services - AI Monetization
themes.thesis_summary: Communication services shifting from AI spending phase to AI profit phase, with companies using AI to improve advertising efficiency and develop new revenue streams. Crowding risk offset by strong fundamental catalyst of earnings acceleration.
key_catalysts: AI monetization phase beginning
Communication Services earnings acceleration to 11.3% in 2026
Digital advertising efficiency improvements from AI
Enterprise AI adoption scaling

themes.name: European Equities - Relative Value Recovery
themes.thesis_summary: European equities offering relative value as smart money diversifies away from US concentration. Defense spending boom and energy security themes provide structural support while valuations remain attractive vs US.
key_catalysts: Smart money flowing to international diversification
Declining correlation with US markets
Defense spending boom in Europe
Valuation gap vs US markets

themes.name: Small-Cap Value - Earnings Revision Divergence
themes.thesis_summary: Small-cap value positioned for relative outperformance as earnings growth expectations diverge favorably vs large caps, while Fed cuts improve lending environment for smaller companies. Extreme underweight creates asymmetric opportunity.
key_catalysts: Non-Mag 7 earnings growth accelerating vs Mag 7 flattening
Fed rate cuts benefiting small-cap lending
Reshoring benefiting domestic-focused companies
Extreme valuation discount to large caps
